text:
A methodical hunter who marks targets with Severance stacks then executes them.

Primary: STR | Secondary: CON

MP mechanic: No MP system - Severance stacks build on enemies via skills. Switching targets resets all stacks. At 5 stacks use Scythe for devastating damage.

Skills:
Severance Strike - +1 stack
Deep Cut - +2 stacks
Scythe - consume stacks for massive damage
Cold Blood - 15sec full MP = max Scythe potential
Evade - 1-tile dodge backward, skips if blocked
Whirlwind - tornado 3 tiles forward
Flourish - 5 rapid forward hits
Cross Slash - X pattern diagonal AoE
Death March - walk 3 tiles slashing everything
Ricochet - melee chain bounce 3 targets
Crippling Blow - single target stun
Slayer's Rush - 2-tile rush + Severance stack on hit
